svg.title: Lithium aluminum hydride ester reduction: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: CH3CO2Et + LiAlH4 → Ester–aluminum encounter ensemble. Carbonyl oxygen coordination/ion pairing organizes hydride delivery; no single aggregate is universally specified.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Carbonyl oxygen coordination/ion pairing organizes hydride delivery; no single aggregate is universally specified.
